expression_set.plain_language: When delivery exceptions occur, we measure response time and on-time recovery so the client learns which response patterns reduce delay.
expression_set.operator: For delivery_exception and exception_response, compare exception_resolution_time inside the 72 hour recovery window using method.time_to_event.v1 and emit only correlation_candidate.
expression_set.executive: CyberAlchemy's advantage is that exception handling becomes measurable operational learning, not a dashboard note that disappears after the shipment closes.
expression_set.contract: OptimizationChainDefinition(optchain.logistics.exception-resolution, delivery_exception, exception_resolution_time, method.time_to_event.v1, Exception Resolution Acceleration, correlation_candidate).
expression_set.causal_careful: This chain can show that faster response patterns correlate with delivery recovery; it does not prove the response caused recovery without stronger comparison gates.
expression_set.dashboard_label: Exception Resolution Acceleration: recovery time after exception response, correlation candidate.
expression_set.ontology: exception_response -> measured_by -> exception_resolution_time_window -> evaluated_with -> method.time_to_event.v1 -> proposes -> Exception Resolution Acceleration.

interpretation_limits: Fixture-level evidence is not causal proof.
Shipment exceptions may be confounded by carrier, lane, weather, and client-specific operating constraints.
Approved reuse requires an owner decision before future routing or agent gates can act on this chain.
contradiction_path: Contradict or retire this chain if later shipments with the same response pattern do not improve recovery time after controlling for lane and carrier.
